summary: Retrieve tracks liked, favorited, or reviewed by a user
description: Returns a list of tracks associated with a user based on the selected relations (like, favorite, review). Supports pagination, sorting, filtering by track type, and audio format options. Either a user id or a valid access token must be supplied alongside the required client_id. The 'audiodownload_allowed' field indicates if the track can be downloaded; if false, the 'audiodownload' field will be an empty string.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap response in a JSONP callback (only for json format and GET requests)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200, 'all' caps at 200)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sorting order: 'updatedate' by last interaction date, or 'rating' by combined relevance

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes the total result count in the header (affects performance)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id (one of id or access_token must be provided)

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 token for the Jamendo user

parameters.name: track_type
parameters.description: Filter by track type; default returns only album tracks

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs to filter

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs to filter

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Select which user relations to include (like, favorite, review). If omitted, all are considered.

notes: Either the 'id' parameter or a valid 'access_token' must be supplied; both can be omitted only if the endpoint is called with anonymous client_id (which returns public data only).
When 'audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'audiodownload' field will be an empty string.
The 'track_type' parameter defaults to 'albumtrack' to avoid issues with older applications.
